metadata.preview:
Minecraft 26.2 -> 26.3 Mod Migration Primer

This is a high level, non-exhaustive overview on how to migrate your mod from 26.2 to 26.3. This does not look at any specific mod loader, just the changes to the vanilla classes. All provided names use the official mojang mappings.

This primer is licensed under the [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), so feel free to use it as a reference and leave a link so that other readers can consume the primer.

If there's any incorrect or missing information, please file an issue on this repository or ping @ChampionAsh5357 in the Neoforged Discord server.

Thank you to:

- @RogueLogix for reviews on the Blaze3d and Renderpearl changes

- @crendgrim since the E key is not the M key

Pack Changes

There are a number of user-facing changes that are part of vanilla which are not discussed below that may be relevant to modders. You can find a list of them on [Misode's version changelog](https://misode.github.io/versions/?id=26.3&tab=changelog).

number-provider breaking | Split the number_provider registry into context_int_provider and context_float_provider to avoid accidental loss of precision due to mixing of float and integer operations.

number-provider breaking | Split some number providers into both context int and context float provider:

* constant

* uniform

* storage

* add (renamed from sum)

* mul (renamed from product)

* min (renamed from minimum)

* max (renamed from maximum)

* avg (renamed from average)

* weighted_list

* conditional

* number_dispatcher

* environment_attribute

number-provider breaking | Moved some number providers only to context int providers:

* binomial

* score

number-provider breaking | Moved number provider enchantment_level only to context float provider.

number-provider | Added new context int provider types:

* abs with field input.

* from_float with field input.

* mod with fields left and right.

datagen | Removed the definition field from the blocks.json datagen report.

options | The white-list server.properties option is now true by default.

item component | Added data component block_transformer, which allows items to transform a block into another block on player interaction. It is a list of objects with fields:

* block_state_provider: used to provider the state of the transformed block. If it returns no result the next rule in the list will be attempted.

* sound: optional sound event to play on interaction.

* particle: optional particles to play on interaction.

* disallowed_faces: optional list of directions.

* loot: optional loot table to drop items on a successful transformation.

* drop_strategy: optional field, either from_middle (default) or clicked_face.

* transform_type: optional field, either single_block (default) or copper_chest.

* consume_on_use: optional boolean, whether the item should be consumed.

* item_damage_per_use: optional integer, how much damage to take with each use.

* When used on a player, the player's attack strength will no longer be reset.

command | Added /compute command which evaluates number providers, with contexts origin and this. Syntax /compute <target> <provider> [<scale>|integer], with:

* <target>: one of default, block <pos>, or entity <selector>.

* <provider>: a number provider ID or inline value.

* <scale>: optional scale value to multiply the final result.
